proof.zero_set_SPD: This is the zero set of VJ-VGram, NOT of VJ. For SPD G choose R=G^1/2 and Gamma=R^-1 Phi. F=0 iff {Gamma_a,Gamma_b}=2delta_ab I. The universal complex Cl4 algebra is M4(C) (its16 monomials are an independent basis, verified here). A unital4-dimensional star representation is faithful and the unique irreducible representation, so Gamma=U GammaCanonical Udag. Every star automorphism of M4 is unitary-inner. Multiplying U by a scalar fixes detU=1 without changing conjugation. The stabilizer in SU4 is Z4. Thus at fixed SPD Gram the complete zero set is one SU4/Z4 orbit, not a separately imposed constraint. Singular Gram is outside this classification.

After X-Y, and the invertible row transform R^-1, the relations linearize to {Z_a,Gamma_b}+{Gamma_a,Z_b}=0. Sending Gamma_a to Z_a defines a derivation of Cl4=M4 because it annihilates its defining relations. Every derivation of M4 is inner; star preservation permits an anti-Hermitian generator, unique modulo iI. Hence X-Y=i[H,Phi] with H traceless Hermitian. Finite-N/finite-Fock matter is at most linear in ||Phi|| with a uniform finite coefficient; Young absorbs it in the quartic. The original positive kinetic form plus this semibounded potential on smooth compact support has a Friedrich extension.
